Questions

Where do the clips come from?

Your own videos — new uploads and your back catalog.

What happens when my 10 free clips run out?

Posting pauses. Your finished clips stay banked — subscribe and they post right away.

Can I choose how long my clips are?

Yes — inside the app. Set lengths per channel in Setup, or per video just by asking in chat. There's nothing to pick at signup.

Do you need my channel passwords?

No. Your ClipsDoneForYou account has its own password. Channels connect through each platform's official sign-in — we never see those passwords.

What if I need more clips than my plan includes?

Posting keeps going at $0.25 per extra clip, billed monthly.
